metadata.image_policy: Same image capped at 2 MP; native processor patch budgets differ; no cache reuse

dataset.scope: 100 macOS target queries, 50 text and 50 icons; public benchmark, possible training contamination; no desktop execution

metadata.limitations: Public positive-target grounding benchmark, possible training overlap. Not overall assistant or task completion accuracy. One greedy sample per target. Background Mac apps uncontrolled. Python MLX runtime, not production Swift. No real clicks or messages.
